headline: Google Vids upgrades AI voiceovers with Gemini 3.8 Flash Lite TTS

verified_story_context.summary: Google Workspace says Google Vids is moving AI voiceovers and avatar narration to Gemini 3.8 Flash Lite TTS to improve naturalness, pacing, context-aware emphasis, and generation latency for faster script and narration iteration.
verified_story_context.why_it_matters: Better narration quality and faster revision can make AI-assisted video more practical for routine training, presentations, explainers, and other knowledge-work communication.

visual.layout: Professional white-background textbook/editorial workflow diagram. Show a left-to-right narration production loop: Script → Gemini 3.8 Flash Lite TTS → Narrated audio → Preview & revise loop → Google Vids timeline. Make the revision loop visibly return from preview to script/TTS.
visual.mechanism: A script enters Gemini text-to-speech; the TTS stage controls naturalness, pacing and context-aware emphasis while reducing generation latency; narrated audio is previewed; revisions loop back rapidly; approved narration is placed into the final Google Vids timeline.
visual.alt_text: Textbook workflow showing a script moving through Gemini 3.8 Flash Lite text-to-speech, narrated audio, rapid preview and revision, and final placement in a Google Vids timeline.
visual.style: professional high-detail textbook/editorial workflow; white background; crisp mechanism-first composition; legible non-overlapping text; no people, humanoid figures, cinematic scenes, stock imagery, dashboard screenshots, or decorative promotional art
